Trigger / Threshold: Migration cannot be corrected before latest safe finish
Detection Evidence: Migration errors, missing dependencies, elapsed time
Decision Authority: Program Sponsor with Business and Technical Leads
Integration / Schedule Action: Disable production schedules and restore prior connection state
Downstream / File Action: Quarantine superseded files and notify downstream consumers
Validation: Login, metadata, rules, forms, security, balances, and job validation
Communication: Send rollback decision and continuity instructions

Trigger / Threshold: Material data or calculation integrity failure
Detection Evidence: Unreconciled control totals, repeatability failure, material variance
Application Action: Restore application or approved configuration checkpoint
Data Action: Restore or reload approved pre-cutover data state
Integration / Schedule Action: Stop jobs and prevent duplicate source processing
Validation: Full-precision source, Plan1, ASO, dashboard, and Smart View reconciliation

Detection Evidence: Unauthorized access, blocked critical user, approval-path failure
Application Action: Restore approved security and workflow configuration
Data Action: Protect submitted data and audit history
Validation: Positive and negative access, task ownership, approvals, audit, and login tests
Communication: Send controlled access and operating instructions

Detection Evidence: Critical-path forecast beyond approved opening or recovery threshold
Integration / Schedule Action: Stop or reschedule integrations and jobs
Validation: Service, balances, access, jobs, dependencies, and support acceptance
Communication: Send No-Go and revised deployment checkpoint
